title: dossier.json — what the record holds about one person
description: Written by the scout; the numbers in `computed` are written ONLY by tools/richness.py, never by hand or by a model.

aliases.description: Every form of the name the sources use — surname, married name, initials. Used to measure words about the subject.

identityBasis.description: How membership of the series is established: self-identification or a reliable biography (voice.md §7).

identitySource.description: The source id that supports identityBasis.

lifeStage.description: youth | arrival | work | family | public life | later life | … — distinct stages decide biography vs episode.

evidence.description: A verbatim quote of at least thresholds.minQuoteWords words from one of `sources`, copied from `richness.py mentions`. Checked whenever present; required for the event to count when thresholds.eventEvidenceRequired is true.

deadEnds.description: Clues that could not be confirmed, and where they came from (sourcing.md §2).

communityReview.description: Publishing waits for a reader from the community (default true for Indigenous Seattle).

computed.description: Written by richness.py dossier: counts, tier, mode, ceilingWords, estimatedChapters, first/lastEventYear, unmet.
